output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The buy function has an integer overflow where the amount is calculated as msg.value / buyPrice, but no check is made to ensure that msg.value is a valid amount.
The sell function has an integer overflow where the amount is calculated as this.balance / sellPrice, but no check is made to ensure that this.balance is a valid amount.
